fi-hemichromis-bimaculatus.title: Jewel Cichlid
fi-hemichromis-bimaculatus.summary: The jewel cichlid, Hemichromis bimaculatus, is a cichlid from Africa's western coast, between southern Guinea and central Liberia. Regularly seen in the trade and often sold as a community fish, it…
rows: Pairs or small groups depending on setup
Will eat nearly anything offered, though live foods will help to enhance the colouration of the fish.
Widespread down Africa 's western coast from South Guinea to Central Liberia .
notes: Provide a roomy aquarium with as many hiding places as possible to help disperse aggresion and provide sanctuary.
This can be achieved through the use of clay flower pots, rockwork arranged to form caves, driftwood and areas of dense planting.

fi-pelvicachromis-pulcher.title: Pelvicachromis pulcher
fi-pelvicachromis-pulcher.summary: The kribensis, Pelvicachromis pulcher, is a cichlid from Nigeria and Cameroon, found in still and slow-moving, heavily vegetated waters. One of the most common cichlids in the hobby since the 1950s,…
rows: Pairs or small groups depending on setup
notes: The tank should contain plenty of hiding places and potential spawning sites.
Clay pots and caves, roots and pieces of driftwood can all be used.
